simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דִּין (H1780) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: דִּין (dîyn) means judgement. First listed occurrence: Dan 4 34.

definitions.full: H1780. din דִּין noun masculine Ezra 7:26 judgement ; — absolute ׳ד Dan 4:34 = justice (of ways of God); emphatic מִנֵּהּ מִתְעֲבֵד דִּינָה Ezra 7:26 judgment be executed upon him ; דִּינָא = judges, court Dan 7:10 , 26 +? 7:22 (reading יְהִב ׳וְד [ וְשָׁלְטָנָא יְתִב ], Ew Bev Kmp Dr); ᵑ0 however = judgment was given in favour of (see Dr).
